n-k-k7-02.title: Isilothi esisodwa samashejuli amathathu
n-k-k7-02.goal: Guqula ukutholakala okungashiwo ngokuphelele kwabantu abathathu kube yizimo ezinembile, wakhe izikhathi zokuhlangana eziningana ezanelisa bonke, bese ubona ukuthi ushintsho olulodwa lushintsha kanjani izinketho.
n-k-k7-02.material:
Abafundi abathathu behlela umhlangano owodwa wokufunda kule viki. Umhlangano uthatha amahora amabili.

민수: 이번 주에 스터디를 한 번 하면 어때요? 두 시간쯤 걸려요.
지연: 저는 월요일은 아르바이트가 있어서 안 돼요. 다른 날은 오후 4시부터 괜찮아요.
민수: 저는 수요일은 안 돼요. 그리고 화요일 말고는 수업이 6시에 끝나서 6시 이후에만 가능해요.
수진: 저는 금요일은 안 돼요. 그리고 9시까지는 모임이 끝나야 해요.

(Zonke izikhathi zingu-p.m. ngaphandle uma isikhathi sisho okunye. '6시 이후' ihlanganisa ihora lesi-6, futhi '9시까지 끝나야 해요' ivumela umhlangano ukuphela ngo-9 ncamashi.)
n-k-k7-02.prereq.0: Wazi amagama ezinsuku zeviki nezikhathi zewashi
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.prompt: 민수 usho ukuthini nge-'화요일 말고는 수업이 6시에 끝나서 6시 이후에만 가능해요'?
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.hint.0: Thola igama elihlukanisa uLwesibili ezinye izinsuku, bese ubuza ukuthi lisusa ini kuLwesibili.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sho umusho ngamagama akho kabili: kanye kuLwesibili futhi kanye ezinye izinsuku.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.a: Angahlangana kuphela ngoLwesibili, hhayi ezinye izinsuku.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.r.a: '말고는' ihlukanisa uLwesibili ezinye izinsuku; ayisho ukuthi uLwesibili yilona kuphela usuku.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.b: Angahlangana nganoma yimuphi usuku ngemuva kuka-6, kodwa ngoLwesibili hhayi ngaphambi kuka-6.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.r.b: Uma uLwesibili belufana nezinye izinsuku, bekungeke kube nesizathu sokulubiza ngokwehlukana.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.c: NgoLwesibili akanawo umkhawulo onjalo; ezinsukwini ezinye kuphela ngemuva kuka-6.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.d: Amakilasi akhe aphela ngo-6 nsuku zonke, kufaka noLwesibili.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.r.d: Khona-ke '화요일 말고는' ayinakuba nencazelo; uLwesibili uyisihlukanisi.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.explain: 'A 말고는 B' isho 'ngaphandle kuka-A, B'. Ezinsukwini zonke ngaphandle koLwesibili umkhawulo wangemuva kuka-6 uyasebenza; uLwesibili uyisihlukanisi. (ULwesithathu uvalwa umusho wakhe wangaphambilini.)
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.prompt: Thola izikhathi ezi-3 ezihlukene zomhlangano ezifanele wonke umuntu. d = inombolo yosuku lokusebenza (1 = uMsombuluko ... 5 = uLwesihlanu), h = isikhathi sokuqala ngamahora aphelele ewashini lamahora angu-24 (isibonelo 16 isho 4 p.m.). Umhlangano uthatha amahora amabili.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sika izinsuku okungekho ongakwazi ukuza kuzo kuqala, bese unquma isikhathi sokuqala sokuqala nesokugcina kusuku ngalunye oluseleyo.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.hint.1: Isikhathi sokuphela yisikhathi sokuqala kanye namahora amabili; hlola ngomkhawulo ka-수진 ekugcineni.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.ok.c0: Inombolo yosuku lokusebenza kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-5 nehora eliphelele.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c0: Sebenzisa inombolo ephelele yosuku lokusebenza kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-5 nehora eliphelele lokuqala.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c2: 지연 ukhululekile kuphela kusukela ngo-4 p.m.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Ngaphandle koLwesibili, 민수 angahlangana kuphela ngemuva kuka-6 p.m.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c6: Umhlangano uthatha amahora amabili futhi kumele uphele ngo-9 p.m.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.explain: UmLwesibili noLwesine kuphela asala ngemuva kwemikhawulo yezinsuku ezintathu. NgoLwesibili noma yisiphi isikhathi sokuqala kusuka ku-4 p.m. kuya ku-7 p.m. siyasebenza; ngoLwesine ukuqala kumele kube ngu-6 noma 7 p.m. (ukuphela kumele kube ngaphambi kuka-9).
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha OLUNYE lwezikhathi zakho bese ulumemezela engxoxweni yeqembu ngesiKorea (-요 enenhlonipho): sho usuku lokusebenza nesikhathi sokuqala.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Thatha umugqa owodwa ongenhla bese usho usuku lwawo nesikhathi ngesiKorea.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Engeza ukuphela kombuzo okufana ne--어때요? noma isiphakamiso esilula nge--해요.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usuku nesikhathi engibhale zihambisana nesinye sezikhathi engizakhile?
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.2: Iqamba usuku olungabalwa ukulukhipha kuphela; lokhu kulungile.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.prompt: Manje 수진 ushintsha umqondo: '금요일도 괜찮아요. 대신 8시까지는 끝나야 해요.' Abanye ababili abashintshi. Kwenzekani ezikhathini ezingenzeka?
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.hint.0: Phinda wenze izimo ngomthetho omusha: isikhathi sokuqala sokugcina manje siyini uma umhlangano kumele uphele ngo-8?
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola uLwesihlanu ngomuntu ngamunye ngokulandelana, bese uqhathanisa izinhlu zikaLwesibili noLwesine nezakho zangaphambilini.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.a: ULwesihlanu ngo-6 p.m. luyavuleka, futhi ukuqala kwamuva ngoLwesibili noLwesine kuyancipha.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.b: Akukho okusha okuvulekile, ngoba 민수 usengakwazi ukuhlangana ngoLwesihlanu.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.c: ULwesihlanu luyavuleka kusuka ku-4 p.m. kuya phambili, njengoLwesibili.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.r.c: ULwesihlanu aluyona uLwesibili: 민수 angahlangana ngoLwesihlanu kuphela ngemuva kuka-6 p.m.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.d: ULwesihlanu luyavuleka, futhi izikhathi zikaLwesine zihlala zinjalo ngqo.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.r.d: Isikhathi sokuphela sangaphambili sinqamula isikhathi sokuqala sokugcina usuku ngalunye, kufaka noLwesine.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.explain: Umthetho omusha uthi: phela ngo-8 p.m., ngakho ukuqala kungu-6 p.m. ngokuphezulu. ULwesihlanu manje ludinga ukuqala ngo-6 p.m. ngqo (민수 udinga ngo-6 noma ngemuva, 수진 manje udinga ngo-6 noma ngaphambili). ULwesibili lulahlekelwa ngo-7 p.m. noLwesine luhlala nango-6 p.m. kuphela.

n-k-k7-01.title: Ukuthunyelwa kwamahhala, kubani?
n-k-k7-01.goal: Hlola izimangalo zabathengi abaningana ngesaziso sokulethwa, uthole ukuthi yiziphi izimangalo isaziso esingazisekeli, bese uxwayisa umngani ngokumele akuhlole.
n-k-k7-01.material:
Umngani wethenga ku-inthanethi futhi ukubonisa isaziso sokulethwa sesitolo. Abathengi abaningana basho abacabanga ukuthi sisho ini.

[배송 안내]
1. 구매 금액이 30,000원 이상이면 배송비는 무료입니다. 단, 쿠폰으로 할인을 받으신 경우에는 할인된 금액을 기준으로 합니다.
2. 제주도와 섬 지역은 배송비 3,000원이 추가됩니다.
3. 오후 2시 이전에 결제하시면 당일에 출고됩니다.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.prompt: Abathengi abane ngamunye bathenge into eyodwa. Ngubani umthengi ozokhokha ngokuqinisekile akukho nhlawulo yokulethwa nhlobo?
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ungaqhathanisi intengo yohlu no-30,000 ngokushesha. Hamba ngomusho ngamunye wesaziso bese uphawula noma yini eshintsha inani eliqhathaniswayo noma wengeza izindleko.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kumthengi ngamunye, bala inani elibalwayo, bese uhlela konke okunye esazisweni okungasebenza kulowo mthengi.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.o.a: 소라 (Seoul): intengo yohlu 33,000원, wasebenzisa ikhuphoni elingu-5,000원
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.a: Ikhuphoni lehlisa inani elibalwayo. 33,000 - 5,000 = 28,000, engaphansi kuka-30,000.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.o.b: 준호 (Jeju Island): intengo yohlu 40,000원, akunalo ikhuphoni
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.b: Inani lakhe liphezulu ngokwanele, kodwa isaziso sengeza inkokhelo ehlukile yesifunda sakhe, ngakho usakhokha okuthile.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.o.c: 민지 (Seoul): intengo yohlu 36,000원, wasebenzisa ikhuphoni elingu-5,000원
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.d: 29,000 ingaphansi kuka-30,000 futhi akukho simo esishintsha lokho.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.explain: 민지 ukhokha 36,000 - 5,000 = 31,000원, okungu-30,000 noma ngaphezulu, futhi i-Seoul ayinayo inkokhelo eyengeziwe. Inani le-소라 ngemva kwekhuphoni ngu-28,000. 준호 uthola ukulethwa kwamahhala kwesisekelo kodwa isaziso sengeza 3,000원 ye-Jeju. 태민 ungaphansi komkhawulo.
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.prompt: Abathengi bakhuluma ngalokho abakuthengile. Khetha umugqa owodwa isimangalo sawo ESINGASEKELWA yisaziso (kungaba nemigqa eminingi enjalo; noma iyiphi iyabalwa).
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.hint.0: Emugqeni ngamunye, bala kabusha inani isitolo esizolisebenzisa, bese uhlola isikhathi noma isifunda uma umugqa ukhuluma ngaso.
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bheka amagama ezinombolo esazisweni: yimaphi amisa umkhawulo, futhi ngukuphi uhlangothi lomkhawulo olwamukelwayo?
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.explain: Imigqa 2 no-4 ayisekelwa. Umugqa 2: 32,000 - 4,000 = 28,000, engaphansi komkhawulo. Umugqa 4: ukulethwa kosuku olufanayo kudinga inkokhelo ngaphambi kuka-2 p.m. Umugqa 1 uhle (31,000, akukho ikhuphoni), umugqa 3 uhambisana nenkokhelo ye-Jeju, futhi umugqa 5 ngu-30,000 ncamashi, ubalwa njenge-'이상'.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.prompt: Umngani ose-제주도 uyakubuza: '3만 원 넘게 사면 무료배송이지?' Phendula ngemisho engu-1-2 yesiKorea (-요 ehloniphekile ilungile; amagama ambalwa esiNgisi ayabekezelelwa) bese umtshela izinto ezimbili esazisweni okumele azihlole ngaphambi kokulindela ukulethwa kwamahhala.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.hint.0: Phinda ufunde umusho ngamunye onenombolo wesaziso bese ubuza ukuthi yimuphi ongashintsha lokho umngani wakho akukhokhayo.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala impendulo embuzweni wakhe kuqala, bese wengeza izimo ezimbili nge-그런데 noma 그리고.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngisho zombili izinto: isifunda sakhe nesaphulelo?
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Impendulo yami ilungisa inkolelo yakhe esikhundleni sokuphinda umthetho?
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.model.2: Njengoba uhlala e-제주도, kukhona 3,000원 eyengeziwe, futhi uma usebenzisa i-쿠폰 intengo encishisiwe yiyona ebalwayo.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Impendulo exubile yesiNgisi isadlula ukuhlola kobuso.

n-k-k7-03.title: Iriviyu iwela kuphi?
n-k-k7-03.goal: Buyekeza ukufunda kwakho kweriviyu yekhefi njengoba ingxenye ngayinye ifika, qaphela ukuthi yimuphi umusho othwala iphuzu lombhali, bese ubhala iseluleko esigcina izinhlangothi zombili.
n-k-k7-03.material: Umfundi wabhala iriviyu ye-inthanethi yekhefi eduze nenyuvesi. Umngane wakho ufuna ukufunda lapho amahora amane ngoMgqibelo. Uzofunda iriviyu ingxenye ngengxenye. (일부러 = ngamabomu, 콘센트 = isikhiye samandla, -(으)ㄹ 만하다 = kuyafaneleka ukwenza)
n-k-k7-03.thinking.1: Ukubona ukuthi iyiphi ingxenye yomusho ethwala umbono
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.prompt: Funda ingxenye ngayinye, khetha impendulo ebonakala inengqondo kakhulu, bese uqhubeka.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nquma usebenzisa kuphela ingxenye oyifundile kuze kube manje.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.hint.1: Engxenyeni ngayinye, bheka ukuthi yimuphi umusho umbhali abonakala eqaphela kakhulu.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Umbhali cishe wayetshela ini umngane ofuna indawo yokufunda?
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Kuze kube manje kunokudunyiswa kuphela, ngakho ukuncoma kuyindlela. Umfundi ocophelelayo angalinda eminye imininingwane.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Umbhali uthi umculo uthi 조용해서, okusho ukuthula.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Hamba lapho kuphela uma uthanda izixuku.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Mhlawumbe hamba, kodwa hlola imininingwane kuqala.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Manje umbhali wayezotshela ini umngane ofuna ukufunda lapho intambama yonke?
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Ingxenye yenkinga ikhuluma ngokuhlala isikhathi eside: izikhiye ezimbalwa, izihlalo eziqinile. Ukudunyiswa kusalungile, kodwa iseluleko sincike ekutheni uhlala isikhathi esingakanani.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Hamba lapho; iyindawo engcono kakhulu yokufunda isikhathi eside.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ngemuva kwe-하지만 umbhali ubiza izinkinga ezibalulekile ekuhlaleni isikhathi eside.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Umbhali usayidumisile indawo; isikhalazo sikhuluma ngokuhlala isikhathi eside.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Thola enye indawo yokufunda isikhathi eside; le ingcono ekuhlaleni isikhashana.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Hamba lapho ukuyofunda isikhathi eside, kodwa letha ishaja yakho.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Iriviyu isho ukuthi ukuhlala isikhathi eside kunzima; ishaja ngeke ilungise izihlalo.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yimuphi umusho ochaza wonke iriviyu ngobulungisa kakhulu?
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Ukuphela kuphinda ukudunyiswa kodwa kuxhumanise nesimo: ihora elilodwa noma amabili. Isifinyezo esilungile sigcina ukudunyiswa nomkhawulo.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ikhefi iphuzu layo eliyinhloko yizinkinga zayo, ukudunyiswa kukhulunywa ngakho nje.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Umusho wokugcina uthi kuyafaneleka uhambo oluyisipesheli lokufunda okufushane, ngakho ukudunyiswa akuyona into eseceleni.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ikhefi enhle, ethulile efanele ukuvakashelwa ukuhlala kokufunda okufushane, hhayi isikhathi eside.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ikhefi eliphelele kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokufunda.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ingxenye yesibili ibiza imikhawulo yangempela yokuhlala isikhathi eside.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ikhefi elifanele ukuhlala kwamahora amane naphezu kwezihlalo.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Umbhali uthi ukuhlala isikhathi eside kunzima, ngakho lokhu kuphikisana neriviyu.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.reflect: Qaphela ukuthi iseluleko sakho sishintshe kanjani. Umusho olandela i-하지만 ne-그래도 ngokuvamile ukhombisa lokho umbhali afuna ukuthi ukhumbule, futhi isifinyezo esilungile kumele sigcine ukudunyiswa kokuqala nomkhawulo wangemuva kanye nesimo (ukuthi uhlala isikhathi esingakanani).
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.prompt: Umngane wakho uhlela ukufunda amahora amane lapho ngoMgqibelo. Mtshele ngesiKorea (noma yisiphi isitayela esinenhlonipho noma sensuku zonke) ukuthi ukululeka ngani, usebenzisa lokho iriviyu ekushoyo.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngengxenye yeriviyu ebaluleke kakhulu emahoreni amane.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.hint.1: Engeza umusho owodwa omfushane ngokuthi indawo ilungele ini.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe iseluleko sami sincike ekutheni uzohlala isikhathi esingakanani?
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngigcine uhlangothi oluhle lweriviyu kanye nenkinga?
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.model.2: Emahoreni amane ngingakhetha enye indawo: ama-의자 aqinile futhi cishe awekho ama-콘센트. Kuhle ihora elilodwa lokufunda.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.modelNote.3: Inikeza isiphetho seriviyu (ukuhlala okufushane kuphela) esikhundleni sokuqamba izihlalo.

n-k-k7-04.title: Isitolo sidinga ukwazi ini?
n-k-k7-04.goal: Nquma ukuthi yiziphi izingcezu zolwazi umlayezo wokuqala wesikhalazo ewudingayo, khetha isicelo esingenakuqondwa kabi, bese ubhala umlayezo.
n-k-k7-04.material: Uyalele ijakhethi ku-inthanethi. Uyalele usayizi L kodwa kufike ijakhethi yosayizi M izolo, futhi awukwazi ukuyigqoka. Uzothumela umlayezo wokuqala esikhungweni samakhasimende sesitolo (고객센터) ubhaliwe. Isisebenzi asikwazi futhi siphendula kuphela ngemuva kokufunda umlayezo wakho.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.prompt: Yiziphi izingcezu zolwazi okufanele umlayezo wakho wokuqala ube nazo ukuze isitolo sixazulule inkinga ngaphandle kokukubhalela emuva ukubuza? Khetha zonke ezisebenzayo.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ungumsebenzi wesitolo: yiliphi iqiniso ongabuza ngalo ngaphambi kokuba wenze noma yini?
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.hint.1: Sika lokho isitolo esinakho kakade noma okungashintshi lokho abakwenzayo okulandelayo.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.a: Inhlonipho ilungile, kodwa ukuxolisa akuyona ulwazi isitolo esidinga ukwenza ngalo.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.c: Isitolo sesinalo ikheli emyalelweni, futhi inombolo yomyalelo ibenza bakuthole.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.o.d: Iyiphi into efikile nokuthi yini engalungile ngayo
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.f: Ukuphuza akuyona inkinga lapha; usayizi ongalungile uyinkinga.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.explain: Isitolo kumele sikwazi ukuthola umyalelo (inombolo yomyalelo), siqonde ukuthi yini engahambanga kahle (into nosayizi), futhi sazi ukuthi ufuna ini ekwenziwe (ukushintshana noma imbuyiselo). Ukuxolisa, ikheli lakho nesikhathi sokulethwa akubasizi ukwenza.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.prompt: Yimuphi umusho wesicelo otshela isitolo ngqo ukuthi senzeni?
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kumusho ngamunye, buza ukuthi isisebenzi singazibuza ini ngemuva kokuwufunda.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.hint.1: Isicelo esihle siphendula 'yenza ini, ukuze uthole ini?'
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.r.a: Lokhu kungasho usayizi owehlukile, umbala ohlukile noma ijakhethi ehlukile; isitolo asikwazi ukusho.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.r.b: Kusho ukuthi kushesha kangakanani, hhayi ukuthi kwenziwe ini.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.explain: 'L 사이즈로 교환해 주세요' iqamba isenzo (교환) nomphumela (usayizi L). Ezinye izicelo zishiya isitolo siqagela ukuthi ufuna ini.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.prompt: Bhala umlayezo wakho ku-고객센터 ngesiKorea (izinga elinenhlonipho noma elisemthethweni, imisho emi-2-4). Qamba inombolo yomyalelo.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.hint.0: Vula ngokubingelela nesigaba esisodwa sokuthi kungani ubhala.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.hint.1: Bese ubeka amaqiniso amathathu ngokulandelana: yimuphi umyalelo, yini engalungile, ufuna ini.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe isisebenzi singasebenza ngomlayezo wami ngaphandle kokubhala emuva?
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe isicelo sami sicacile ngalokho engikufunayo?
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mfushane, -요 enenhlonipho; isaqukethe amaqiniso amathathu adingekayo.

n-k-k7-05.title: Wonke umuntu? Hhayi wonke umuntu
n-k-k7-05.goal: Hlukanisa 'hhayi wonke umuntu' no-'akekho', khetha ubufakazi obuphula ngempela isimangalo se-'wonke umuntu', bese ubhala isimangalo sakho nesibonelo esiphikisayo esinenhlonipho.
n-k-k7-05.material: Ekushintshaneni ngolimi, isivakashi sithi: "한국 사람은 모두 매운 음식을 좋아해요." Wena nabafundi osebenza nabo nifuna ukuphendula ngenhlonipho nangokunembile.
n-k-k7-05.prereq.0: Uyazi i-모두, 다, 항상 ne--지 않다
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.prompt: Phakathi kwabangane abayishumi baseKorea obaziyo, abahlanu bathanda ukudla okunamakha futhi abahlanu abathandi. Yisiphi isitatimende esiyiqiniso?
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bala ukuthi umusho ngamunye ukhuluma ngabangaki kwabayishumi.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuthi umusho usavumela abahlanu abakuthandayo.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.r.a: Lokho bekungasho ukuthi bonke abayishumi abakuthandi.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.r.d: Lokho bekungasho ukuthi bonke abayishumi bayakuthanda.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.explain: '모두 ...는 것은 아니에요' isho ukuthi 'wonke umuntu' akuyona iqiniso, kodwa isavumela abanye abantu ukuthi bakuthande. 'Akekho' kuyisimangalo esiqinile kunamaqiniso.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.prompt: Yisiphi isiqephu esisodwa sobufakazi esanele ukubonisa ukuthi '한국 사람은 모두 매운 음식을 좋아해요' asilungile?
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.hint.0: Isimangalo simayelana nabo bonke abantu baseKorea nokuthanda. Buza ukuthi inketho ngayinye isho ini ngokuthanda, nokuthi ngobani.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola inketho ngayinye: ingabe ingaba yiqiniso uma isimangalo siyiqiniso?
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.r.a: Lona umuntu othanda ukudla okunamakha, okuhambisana nesimangalo.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.r.b: Kukhona izitsha eziningi ezinamakha, kodwa lokho akusho lutho ngomuntu ngamunye ozithandayo.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.r.c: Ukuthanda ukudla okunamakha nokudla kuvamile akuphuli isimangalo, ngoba isimangalo simayelana nokuthanda.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.explain: Isimangalo ngabo bonke singaphulwa umuntu oyedwa ongahambisani. U-민아 ungumKorea ongathandi ukudla okunamakha. Awudingi ukubonisa ukuthi iningi alithandi.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.prompt: Yenza isibhangqwana sakho semigqa ngesiKorea (enenhlonipho). U-A usho okuthile okunamandla kakhulu ngeqembu, esebenzisa igama elifana no-모두, 다 noma 항상 (isibonelo ngabafundi, idolobha noma ukudla). U-B uphendula ngenhlonipho ngesibonelo esiphikisayo esithile futhi usho ukuthi akuyona iqiniso ngabo bonke.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha iqembu olazi kahle, bese ubhala umusho ka-A onegama elilodwa le-'bonke / njalo'.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ku-B, cabanga ngomuntu oyedwa wangempela noma icala elingahambisani, bese usho 'hhayi bonke' esikhundleni sika-'akekho'.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe isimangalo sika-A ngempela simayelana nabo bonke, ngakho isibonelo esisodwa siyasiphula?
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe impendulo ka-B inamandla njengesibonelo, hhayi amandla ngaphezulu?
